verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app backed by a hosted service, so a published API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions a public API, an OpenAPI document, or any downloadable machine-readable spec. Release downloads and SHA256SUMS cover app binaries, not an API spec, and the docs-md probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
